tone_statements.citation: 吴正彪 (Wu Zhengbiao) & 杨光应 (Yang Guangying). 2010. 麻山次方言区苗文方案的设计与使用——兼谈苗族英雄史诗《亚鲁王》的记译整理问题 [Design and use of a Miao orthography for the Mashan sub-dialect area, with remarks on transcribing and translating the epic Yalu Wang]. 民族翻译 (Minzu Fanyi) 2010(3) (cumulative no. 76): 58-65. Article no. 1674-280X(2010)03-0058-08. Open copy:https://web.archive.org/web/20150420085819/http://218.249.224.102/upfile/20115613035615353.pdf
tone_statements.quote: 如麻山次方言就有 32、22、53、42、232、11、55、35、33、13、44、13、21 等十二个不 [2] 同的调值，而罗泊河次方言则仅仅只有 31、55、24、31 等三个不同的调值。 [...] （三）声调及符号（11 个调） [...] 同样，在“母本”的苗文符号中只有八个用来表示声调符号的 字母，而麻山次方言中普遍存在十一个调值的现象，我们只有在原有声调符号的基础上增加了三个 声调符号 p、z、c，这也是符号记音的科学要求。
tone_statements.translation: For instance the Mashan sub-dialect has as many as twelve [sic; thirteen listed] different tone values, 32, 22, 53, 42, 232, 11, 55, 35, 33, 13, 44, 13, 21, whereas the Luobohe sub-dialect has only three, 31, 55, 24, 31. [...] (3) Tones and their symbols (11 tones) [...] Likewise, the 'parent' [Chuanqiandian] Miao orthography has only eight letters for marking tone, whereas eleven tone values are found generally throughout the Mashan sub-dialect, so we had to add three tone letters, p, z and c, to the original tone symbols; this is what accurate transcription requires.
tone_statements.locator: p. 58 (sec. 一, intro) and p. 63 (sec. 三, principle 一); tone table itself p. 62 sec. 一(三) '声调及符号（11 个调）'
tone_statements.summary: Mashan sub-dialect orthography, standard = Dadiba (Zongdi, Central Mashan): 8 historical categories with cat. 1/3/5/6/7 split, 11 distinct values (42 22 55 53 232 11 24 13 33 21 + mergers) written with final letters b p x d z l t c s k f; authors assert 11 tone values hold across all Mashan vernaculars incl. Western (Sidazhai); syllable-final tone letters, no sandhi discussed.

tone_statements.citation: Li Yunbing 李雲兵 (李云兵). 2003. 苗瑤語聲調問題 [Some issues regarding tones in the Miao-Yao languages]. Language and Linguistics 語言暨語言學 4(4): 683-712. Taipei: Institute of Linguistics (Preparatory Office), Academia Sinica.
tone_statements.quote: 苗瑤語語言，有的方言的聲調分化為八類後，因古聲類聲母的全清、次清，陰類調A1、B1、C1、D1分化為兩類，標記為1a、1b，3a、3b，5a、5b，7a、7b，這是苗瑤語聲調分化的第三個層次。以絞坨為例，〈表6〉：
tone_statements.translation: In some Hmong-Mien lects, after the tones had split into eight categories, the yin tones A1, B1, C1, D1 split again into two according to whether the ancient initial was plain voiceless or aspirated, marked 1a/1b, 3a/3b, 5a/5b, 7a/7b; this is the third level of Hmong-Mien tone split.
